title: Publish a custom message
description: A named interface makes a message contract explicit. Publish TargetInfo: visibility, position label and confidence.
steps: Publish at least three valid messages on /target_info from Python. Confidence must be between 0 and 1.
Echo /target_info in a terminal. Change one field and explain why a Twist cannot be published on that same typed topic.
hints: The class is supplied directly in the browser; no interface generator is running.
starterCode:
import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from ros2learn_interfaces.msg import TargetInfo

rclpy.init()
node = Node('student_controller')

# TODO: create a TargetInfo publisher for /target_info
# TODO: publish your status from a timer
rclpy.spin(node)
